title: System settings
scope: Applies to all users · Changes are audited
readOnly: You can view these settings. Editing requires the settings update permission.
unsavedHint: Changes are not active yet. Save to apply them to the relevant operations.
discardDescription: Your draft will be discarded. Saved settings stay in place.
sessionHint: Duration applies to new sign-ins. Existing sessions keep their issued lifetime, with a 30-day absolute limit.
passwordHint: Applies to creation, import, resets and password changes. Existing passwords can still sign in.
uploadHint: Storage currently serves user avatars. PNG, JPEG and WebP are accepted with file-header verification. The deployment manages the storage directory.
avatarRequirements: Choose PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to {{size}} MiB.

errors.load: Could not load settings. Try again.
errors.save: Could not save. Your draft is preserved. Try again.
errors.conflict: Another administrator updated these settings. Your draft is preserved. Refresh the page before editing again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to update settings.
errors.invalid: Enter a valid value within the allowed range.

appName.label: System name
appName.hint: Shown as the brand on the sign-in page.

loginDescription.label: Sign-in description
loginDescription.hint: Explain the purpose of the system or how to sign in.

lockThreshold.label: Account failure threshold
lockThreshold.hint: Temporarily block sign-in after this many failures in the window.

ipLockThreshold.label: IP failure threshold
ipLockThreshold.hint: Limit incorrect attempts from the same IP; valid accounts can still sign in.

lockWindowMs.label: Failure window
lockWindowMs.hint: Only failures within this window count; locks expire with the records.

sessionTtlMs.label: Session duration
sessionTtlMs.hint: Sliding lifetime for ordinary sessions, renewed after the activity threshold.

sessionRememberTtlMs.label: Remember-me duration
sessionRememberTtlMs.hint: Lifetime for persistent sign-in sessions, up to 30 days.

minLength.label: Minimum length
minLength.hint: New passwords must contain this many characters, between 8 and 128.

requireSymbol.label: Require symbol
requireSymbol.hint: Include a non-letter, non-digit, non-whitespace symbol.

avatarMaxMiB.label: Avatar size limit
avatarMaxMiB.hint: Maximum size per avatar file, between 1 and 10 MiB.
